title: Negative branch jump
statement: Suppose the code at position $\mathrm{pos}$ begins with a branch instruction that jumps to $l$ when the tested register is negative. If that register contains the word encoding $-1$ and $-1$ lies in the signed range $-2^{W-1}\le -1<2^{W-1}$, then one machine step takes the program counter from $\mathrm{pos}$ to $l$ without changing memory.
hypotheses_covered: Code at pos begins with a branch-on-negative instruction targeting l
Tested register contains the word encoding −1
